Serialize XML

Source: R/write.R
xml_serialize.Rd

Writes a node and its subtree back to XML text.

Usage

xml_serialize(x, declaration = FALSE)

xml_write(x, path, declaration = TRUE)

# S3 method for class 'zuxml_nodeset'
as.character(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'zuxml_document'
as.character(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A zuxml_document, node, or nodeset.

declaration

Prepend an XML declaration.

path

File to write to.

...

Ignored.

Value

xml_serialize() returns a character vector, one element per node. xml_write() returns path invisibly.

Details

Element order, attribute order, text order, mixed-content interleaving and namespace semantics are preserved. The original formatting is not: parsing does not retain quote style, whitespace between attributes, CDATA boundaries, entity spelling, or whether an empty element was written as <a/> or <a></a>. zuxml is not a lossless source editor.

Examples

doc <- xml_parse("<p>Hello <em>XML</em> world</p>")
xml_serialize(doc)
#> [1] "<p>Hello <em>XML</em> world</p>"
